name: Prometheus Flesh-Guilds
identity: Cyborg tech-surgeons and stitched brutes. They harvest scrap and organs from the dead around them and graft permanent upgrades onto their units mid-battle: a slow start that becomes a custom monster by Round 3.

rules.name: Organ & Scrap Harvest
rules.description: When any unit (friend or foe) is destroyed within 6″ of a Prometheus unit, gain 1 Graft (max 3 banked). When a unit activates, spend 1 Graft to give it ONE permanent upgrade for the rest of the battle: +1 PEN on one weapon · +1 to Hit with one weapon · heal D3 MIGHT and +1 MIGHT maximum (once). Each unit can take each upgrade once.

rules.name: Gamble — Over-Graft
rules.description: Spend 2 Grafts on one unit at once for two different upgrades, then roll a D6: on a 1 the unit suffers D3 Fatal Wounds and loses one of the new upgrades (your choice). (Risk: durability + resource.)

rules.name: Bloodied Instruments
rules.description: Field Surgery and Master of Flesh-Grafting heal +1. Grafts may also be gained when a friendly unit loses its last model within 6″ of a Leader.

enhancements.name: Bone-Saw of Prometheus
enhancements.description: **Arch-Chirurgeon Prime** only. The attached unit has UNYIELDING 5+.

enhancements.name: Reserve Organs
enhancements.description: **Rust-Priest Chirurgeon** only. Field Surgery may be used twice per round.

stratagems.name: Adrenal Shunt
stratagems.turn: A unit is selected to Fight
stratagems.effect: +1 Attack; it suffers 1 Fatal Wound afterward.

stratagems.name: Stitch Them Back
stratagems.effect: Return D3 slain models to a Class 1 unit within 6″ of a Leader.

detachments.name: Forge-Legion
detachments.playstyle: Cyborg infantry phalanxes that switch protocols each round.

rules.name: Bionic Imperatives
rules.description: Command Phase, choose for the army: Protector (+1 ARM against attacks from more than 12″; ranged weapons gain [HEAVY]) or Conqueror (ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT] and +1 PEN within 9″).

enhancements.name: Command Uplink
enhancements.description: **Signal-Augur** only. Friendly units within 9″ re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Override Protocol
stratagems.effect: Use the other Imperative for this unit this activation.

stratagems.name: Binharic Volley
stratagems.turn: Two units target the same enemy

detachments.name: Galvanic Breach
detachments.playstyle: Lightning-coils and arc weapons: trade your own MIGHT for damage.

rules.name: Lightning-Coil Overload
rules.description: When a unit is selected to Shoot or Fight, it may suffer 1 Fatal Wound: its weapons gain [IMPALING HITS] this activation.

enhancements.name: Capacitor Heart
enhancements.description: **Graft-Knight Paragon** only. Melee critical hits on 5+ (auto-wound).

enhancements.name: Storm-Coil Mantle
enhancements.description: **Arch-Chirurgeon Prime** only. Units within 6″ ignore the Fatal Wound from Overload on a 4+.

stratagems.name: Chain Lightning
stratagems.turn: An Overloaded attack destroys a unit
stratagems.effect: Inflict D3 Fatal Wounds on another enemy unit within 6″.

stratagems.name: Grounding Rods
stratagems.turn: A unit is hit by an [PSYCHIC / ARCANE] attack
stratagems.effect: It gets WARD 5+ against that attack.

stratagems.name: Discharge
stratagems.effect: The charging unit suffers D3 Fatal Wounds on a 4+.
